subject.title: fix: chat replies are silently dropped when the reply receipt reads the wrong session

question: Should this narrowly evidenced receipt-state repair land once real split-session delivery proof is supplied, while the broader open Telegram regression remains separately tracked?
rationale: The code addresses one defined false-negative path, but the contributor has not yet shown this exact revision running on the affected host; maintainers must decide whether the bounded reliability improvement is acceptable independently of the broader regression.

options.title: Require focused live proof before landing
options.body: Request a redacted sandboxed channel run that shows the normal reply path succeeds exactly once while authorization remains unchanged.

options.title: Pause for a broader recovery diagnosis
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want one integrated explanation and repair for all restart-recovery ownership refusals before changing receipt selection.
